name: Worgen in the Woods
summary: In Duskwood, Nightbane Dark Runners press closer to Darkshire. Calor sends you into the Rotting Orchard to thin their ranks before the pack can surround the town.

sections.title: A Tightening Perimeter
sections.body: Calor's scouting has revealed a greater danger than the lone worgen first seen weaving shadowy magic at the forest's edge. Larger and swifter Nightbane Dark Runners have gathered in the Rotting Orchard, just southwest of Darkshire. They make up most of the pack and have turned the orchard into a staging ground within striking distance of the village gates.

sections.title: An Inexhaustible Tide
sections.body: The Night Watch gains only brief relief when you fell a Dark Runner. Calor sees another prowling the mists in its place, and the defenders cannot explain the Nightbane's resilience or their numbers. They look to veteran monster hunters such as Master Jonathan Carevin to discover what foul catalyst called these alien horrors to Duskwood.

faq.answer: Nightbane Dark Runners are larger, imposing worgen who make up the main front-line force of the pack haunting Duskwood. Unlike the mystical Shadow Weavers, they rely on speed, claws, and predatory ferocity.

faq.q: Where is the Rotting Orchard located?
faq.answer: The Rotting Orchard lies just southwest of Darkshire. Once productive farmland, it is now a corrupted, blighted clearing that the Nightbane pack has seized as a foothold near the town.
Calor is a ranger in Darkshire who serves Master Jonathan Carevin. He scouts the settlement's outskirts and tracks the worgen packs threatening the town's survival.

faq.q: Why do the worgen numbers seem endless to the defenders?
faq.answer: The defenders do not understand the supernatural nature of the worgen presence. They believe an evil power is summoning or drawing the beasts into Duskwood, so fresh waves appear as quickly as others are slain.

Master Jonathan Carevin leads his family's fight against the undead and other evils of Duskwood from Darkshire. Calor trusts his expertise to find the cause of the monstrous infestations troubling the region.

faq.q: How does this task fit into the defense of Darkshire?
faq.answer: Darkshire is isolated, its supplies dwindling, and Stormwind has sent no aid. Clearing the Rotting Orchard keeps the Nightbane from staging direct, overwhelming ambushes on the town's southwest perimeter.

angles.text: Duskwood has received almost no reinforcement from the Stormwind crown. Local volunteers in the Night Watch rely on traveling Alliance heroes to thin the predator packs pressing in.
As a hunter, you face unnatural, bipedal wolves at the Rotting Orchard, whose instincts defy Azeroth's natural order.
